title: The Market in 2050
author: InvestigatorOwn2028
selftext:
Donald Fagen sang in his 1982 song “I.G.Y” of world in which “machines make big decisions,” a world in which they are “programmed with compassion and vision.” I think that’s the world we’re rapidly approaching. 

Contrary to the luddites who claim that AI will enslave humanity to machines, I believe it will eventually liberate humanity from wage labor through universal basic income and near universal ownership of capital.

The purpose of algorithmic trading insofar as I see it is to correct the current inefficiencies of the market and make it less susceptible to corrections and crashes. 

In 2050, I see a world where the machines do indeed make the big decisions, and it will be to the benefit of all of us. Once the process of economic exchange has been fully rationalized, humanity will enjoy a level of capital wealth the likes of which the world has never seen.

For the sake of civilization, we need to stop seeing innovation in trading as a competition and begin to see it as a scientific enterprise which a will one day eradicate poverty and war. 

That is our historical purpose.
